name: Kararavinde Padaravindam
text:
करारविन्देन पदारविन्दं मुखारविन्दे विनिवेशयन्तम् ।
वटस्य पत्रस्य पुटे शयानं बालं मुकुन्दं मनसा स्मरामि ॥
meaning: I meditate on the child Mukunda, lying in the fold of a banyan leaf, placing his lotus foot in his lotus mouth with his lotus hand.
purpose: A tender contemplation of the child Krishna.
when: At the close of the day.
